tests.title: Submit Patent Application: Create and submit a complete patent application for institutional processing.
Track Application Status and History: View the current status, progress, and recorded history of the Applicant's own applications.
Manage Co-Inventors and Agreements: Maintain inventor identities, ownership shares, consents, and agreements for an application.
Search and Attach Prior Art: Search prior-art sources and attach selected references to an application.
Revise and Resubmit Application: Revise an application after a Needs Revision or Rejected decision and resubmit it for a new review cycle.
Withdraw Patent Application: Withdraw an application when the applicable pre-filing status permits withdrawal.
Assign Application to Director: Assign a Submitted application to an eligible Director and start the review timeline.
Review Patent Application: Review an assigned application and record one supported technical-merit decision.
Review and Decide Patent Budget: Review filing/prosecution costs and record a budget decision or escalation.
Assign Attorney to Approved Application: Select and assign an eligible Attorney to an Approved application.
Accept or Decline Attorney Assignment: Record the assigned Attorney's acceptance or decline decision.
Conduct Patentability Assessment: Record legal/patentability analysis and a supported filing recommendation.
Prepare and Record External Patent Filing: Prepare a filing package, perform supported validation, submit externally, and record filing confirmation in PMS.
Record Patent Office Communication: Record official patent-office communication, including an office action, for lifecycle tracking.
Respond to Office Action: Prepare, finalize, and record submission of an office-action response within applicable timing rules.
Monitor Deadlines and Escalations: Monitor calculated deadlines, reminders, missed-deadline escalations, and pending actions.
Manage Post-Grant Tracking and Maintenance: Track granted patents, maintenance schedules, renewal decisions, and recorded maintenance actions.
Make Maintenance Renewal Decision: Record the required Renew or Do Not Renew decision for an upcoming maintenance deadline.
Manage Document Versions: Upload, version, archive, and access application documents under role/status controls.
Submit Licensing or Technology-Transfer Request: Submit a licensing or technology-transfer request linked to patent/IP records.
Review Licensing or Technology-Transfer Request: Review a request routed to the Director and record negotiation/final-agreement information within PMS authority.
File Appeal Against Rejection: Submit a supported appeal against a Rejected application within the applicable appeal period.
Review Appeal: Review an appeal and record one permitted appeal outcome.
Generate System-Wide PMS Reports and Analytics: Generate authorized system-wide PMS reports, dashboards, analytics, schedules, and exports.
Manage PMS Roles and Configuration: Manage PMS-specific configuration and role assignments within module scope.
Maintain Attorney Panel and Expertise Mappings: Maintain approved attorney-panel membership and expertise mappings used by assignment.
Monitor Workflow and Handle Exceptional Cases: Monitor PMS workflows and handle/route conflicts, delayed actions, escalations, and exceptional cases within PMS scope.
View Audit Trail and Compliance Logs: View audit/compliance records for authorized verification or forensic analysis.
Review Office-Action Response: Review and approve an Attorney-prepared office-action response when the applicable process requires Applicant review.
View Own Application Reports: View report information for the Applicant's own patent applications.
View PMS Reports and Analytics: Generate/view PMS reports and analytics within the Director's authorized scope.
View Application Workflow Oversight: View workflow oversight information for applications in the Director's domain.
Record Patent Legal Advice: Record legal advice associated with a patent application throughout its lifecycle.
